proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ X c hX hc
  set m := ∫ ω, X ω ∂P with hm
  set s := ProbabilityTheory.variance X P with hs
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := ProbabilityTheory.variance_nonneg X P
  set u := s / c with hu
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := div_nonneg hs0 hc.le
  have hcu : 0 < c + u := by linarith
  have hsum : 0 < s + c ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hLY : MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun ω => X ω - m + u) 2 P := (hX.sub (MeasureTheory.memLp_const m)).add (MeasureTheory.memLp_const u)
  have hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => (X ω - m + u) ^ 2) P := hLY.integrable_sq
  have hvar : ∫ ω, (X ω - m + u) ^ 2 ∂P = s + u ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : (fun ω => (X ω - m + u) ^ 2) = fun ω => (X ω - m) ^ 2 + 2 * u * (X ω - m) + u ^ 2 := by
      funext ω; ring
    have hi1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => (X ω - m) ^ 2) P := (hX.sub (MeasureTheory.memLp_const m)).integrable_sq
    have hi2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => X ω - m) P := (hX.integrable one_le_two).sub (MeasureTheory.integrable_const m)
    have e1 : ∫ ω, (X ω - m) ^ 2 + 2 * u * (X ω - m) + u ^ 2 ∂P = ∫ ω, ((X ω - m) ^ 2 + 2 * u * (X ω - m)) ∂P + ∫ _ω, u ^ 2 ∂P := MeasureTheory.integral_add (hi1.add (hi2.const_mul _)) (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _)
    have e2 : ∫ ω, ((X ω - m) ^ 2 + 2 * u * (X ω - m)) ∂P = ∫ ω, (X ω - m) ^ 2 ∂P + ∫ ω, 2 * u * (X ω - m) ∂P := MeasureTheory.integral_add hi1 (hi2.const_mul _)
    have e3 : ∫ ω, X ω - m ∂P = 0 := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub (hX.integrable one_le_two) (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _)]
      simp [hm]
    rw [h1, e1, e2, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, e3]
    have hv : s = ∫ ω, (X ω - m) ^ 2 ∂P := ProbabilityTheory.variance_eq_integral hX.aemeasurable
    rw [← hv]
    simp
  have h := MeasureTheory.mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => sq_nonneg (X ω - m + u)) hint ((c + u) ^ 2)
  rw [hvar] at h
  have hsub : P.real {ω | m + c ≤ X ω} ≤ P.real {ω | (c + u) ^ 2 ≤ (X ω - m + u) ^ 2} := by
    refine MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono (fun ω hω => ?_) (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _)
    have : c + u ≤ X ω - m + u := by simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hω; linarith
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hcu.le this 2
  have hb : P.real {ω | m + c ≤ X ω} ≤ (s + u ^ 2) / (c + u) ^ 2 := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    calc _ ≤ P.real {ω | (c + u) ^ 2 ≤ (X ω - m + u) ^ 2} * (c + u) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsub (by positivity)
      _ = (c + u) ^ 2 * P.real {ω | (c + u) ^ 2 ≤ (X ω - m + u) ^ 2} := mul_comm _ _
      _ ≤ _ := h
  have he : (s + u ^ 2) / (c + u) ^ 2 = s / (s + c ^ 2) := by
    rw [hu]
    field_simp
    ring
  rwa [he] at hb
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ), MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 P → 0 < c → P.real {ω | (∫ ω, X ω ∂P) + c ≤ X ω} ≤ ProbabilityTheory.variance X P / (ProbabilityTheory.variance X P + c ^ 2)
